title: 第684章 受伤的总是饕餮第683章 玄度大人待她恩重如山怎么会骗她呢
slug: 妖魔邪祟明明都是祥瑞
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：妖魔邪祟？明明都是祥瑞！
第一卷：默认第684章受伤的总是饕餮（..la）饕餮的双眼猛地瞪圆了。
他的眼眶以肉眼可见的速度泛红，鼻头酸得厉害，两行眼泪不受控制地哗啦啦往下淌。
“我操——操操操操操！
！”
饕餮一边哭一边骂，满脸是泪，涕泗横流。
“老妖婆你他妈搞什么！”
“咱们有话好好说，别发疯！”
他两条粗胳膊一伸，直接把红袖整个人拦腰抱住了。
红袖被他箍在怀里，指甲暴涨，十根鲜红的长指甲直接扎进了饕餮肥厚的肚皮里。
疼倒是不疼，只是指甲上沾染的情力像毒蛇一样钻进饕餮的皮肤。
饕餮一个五大三粗的汉子，此刻哭得像个三岁的孩子。
“别、别这么玩我啊姑奶奶！
！”
“求你了，我真的求你了行不行？”
“我一个大老爷们，哭、哭得好丢人！
！”
红袖在他怀里剧烈地挣扎，披头散发，眼眶底下泛着猩红的血丝，整张脸扭曲到狰狞。
她张嘴想骂些什么，但嗓子里涌上来的只有一连串含混的嘶吼，往日风情万种的模样消失得一干二净。
那具美人皮囊之下，此刻露出来的，是十万年前那个被绑在祭坛上，浑身画满朱砂符咒，被火焰一寸一寸吞没的凶恶厉鬼。

原形毕露。
陈舟在红袖情力爆开的一瞬间就感知到了。
他的诡域全面笼罩住红袖，指尖凝出一缕黑色的细丝，形成了怨憎之种。
陈舟用最短的时间把怨憎之种种入红袖的识海，然后一路下沉，扎进她体内翻涌的情潮之中。
陈舟闭上眼，发动了邪神耳语。
红袖的挣扎顿了一瞬。
但情力反噬实在是太猛了，红袖的识海里翻涌着的不仅仅是她自己的情感，还有天哭星所逸散出来的悲恸。
陈舟的眉头拧紧了。
红袖短时间内稳不下来，她体内的情感洪流过于浓烈，怨憎之种需要时间生根。
但时间恰恰是他们最缺的东西。
红袖身上那股浓郁的香气开始不受控制地往外涌。
那是她情力溢出的具象，香气弥漫开来。
content_en:

Volume 1: Default Chapter 684 The one who gets hurt is always Taotie (..la) Taotie’s eyes suddenly widened.
His eye sockets turned red at a speed visible to the naked eye, his nose was sore, and two lines of tears flowed down uncontrollably.
“Fuck-fuck-fuck-fuck-fuck!
! "
Taotie was crying and cursing at the same time, with tears streaming down his face.
"Old witch, what the hell are you doing!"
"Let's talk carefully if we have something to say, don't go crazy!"
He stretched out his two thick arms and hugged Hongxiu's entire body.
Hongxiu was held in his arms, her nails swelled, and ten long bright red nails dug directly into Taotie's fat belly.
It doesn't hurt at all, it's just that the emotion stained on the nails burrowed into Taotie's skin like a poisonous snake.
Taotie, a tall and thick man, was crying like a three-year-old child.
"Don't, don't play with me like this, aunt!
! "
"Please, I really beg you, okay?"
“I’m a grown man, it’s so embarrassing to cry!
! "
Hongxiu struggled violently in his arms, her hair disheveled, scarlet bloodshot eyes under her eyes, and her whole face twisted to a ferocious state.
She opened her mouth to curse, but all that came out of her throat was a series of indistinct roars, and the charming look she had in the past disappeared completely.
Under that beautiful skin, what was revealed at this moment was the ferocious ghost who was tied to the altar a hundred thousand years ago, covered with cinnabar spells, and engulfed by the flames inch by inch.
True colors revealed.
Chen Zhou sensed the moment Hongxiu's passion exploded.
His mysterious domain completely enveloped Hongxiu, and a black filament condensed from his fingertips, forming a seed of resentment.
Chen Zhou used the shortest possible time to plant his resentment and hatred into Hong Xiu's sea of ​​consciousness, and then he sank all the way down, plunging into the surging tide of love in her body.
Chen Zhou closed his eyes and activated the Evil God Whisper.
Hongxiu's struggle paused for a moment.
But the backlash of emotion was too strong. Hong Xiu's sea of ​​consciousness was filled with not only her own emotions, but also the grief emanating from the Sky Crying Star.
Chen Zhou's brows tightened.
Hongxiu couldn't stabilize in a short period of time, the emotional torrent in her body was too strong, and the seeds of resentment needed time to take root.
But time is exactly what they lack most.
The rich fragrance from Hongxiu's body began to flow out uncontrollably.
It was the concrete manifestation of her passion, and the fragrance filled the air.
